jasper (sales): Heads-up — CedarBank on POC is hitting sporadic TTFT regressions during demos. They see 600ms-1.8s on 30-80 token responses. Call in 30m. Can we triage quickly?
rima (eng-runtime): What region/pool are they hitting and model variant?
jasper (sales): Hosted / us-east-1, model: redwood-chat-medium-quant. Pool name: cedar-poc-01. They also got some 429s during spikes.
theo (eng-sre): 429s + TTFT often means queue headroom + burst protection. I checked metrics: around 14:02 UTC we hit concurrent_requests ~220 -> throttle. Also batch_hold_time shows a bimodal distribution 10ms and 140ms.
tina (solutions): Do they have high prompt prefix similarity? If so kv-cache works well, else misses add up.
jasper (sales): Prompts are similar system prompt + unique user messages. They expect chat snappiness.
rima (eng-runtime): Two quick experiments: 1) reduce batch_window_ms to 8ms and max_batch_size to 12 for that pool, 2) enable per-route small prefill (prefill_tokens:1). Both reduce TTFT at cost of throughput. Want me to flip now?
jasper (sales): Do it. Also Cedar asked if Dedicated removes these issues and what pricing looks like.
amanda (acct exec): Dedicated reduces noisy neighbor throttles; we can offer a 3-month trial at 50% reserved price and 5k demo burst credits. I'll DM formal numbers.
theo (eng-sre): Follow-up: we saw KV store shard rebalance around 14:00 due to autoscaler churn -> cold-kv on some pods causing kv_miss spikes. Suggest pinning min_replicas to avoid churn during demo.
rima (eng-runtime): I'll deploy config: batch_window_ms=8, max_batch_size=12, prefill_tokens=1, min_replicas=2 for cedar-poc-01. Deploy starts now.
billing-bot: quota update: applied 5000 demo credits to customer cedarbank@example.com @ 1777777782
rima (eng-runtime): Tell Cedar to run this trace command and paste output so I can map request id -> pod logs:
```
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Trace: true" -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-medium-quant","input":"<sample>","trace":true}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer | jq .trace
```
theo (eng-sre): Also collect X-Request-Id from their client; that'll make correlating easier.
tina (solutions): Security: Cedar asked where logs are stored and retention. We'll send SOC2 summary and retention policy (30 days by default for hosted, enterprise options for longer). I'll attach docs to the support ticket.
jasper (sales): Cedar pasted one sample trace: {"req":"r-zz9","batch_wait_ms":142,"kv_hits":0,"kv_misses":7,"model_ms":28} — looks like combined batch wait + misses.
rima (eng-runtime): Yep that's cold-kv + batching hold. After config push, expect batch_wait_ms <20ms and kv_misses down if warm replicas stick. If still bad, fallback to quantized-small variant.
amanda (acct exec): If they take Dedicated we can include an onboarding warmup run (one-off) to prepopulate KV for top prefixes. That's part of the TA package.
jasper (sales): On the call they also asked about cost delta if we lower batch window (will this spike their per-token cost?).
ambilling (note): sorry small typo.
amanda (acct exec): Lowering batching will increase compute cost per-token slightly since throughput drops; for POC we can absorb demo delta within credits. For production we can size Dedicated to be cost-effective. I'll include a simple cost example in the follow-up email.
rima (eng-runtime): Done: rollout finished @ 1777777823. Watch metrics and paste traces if they still see spikes.
theo (eng-sre): I added a pod warmup snippet to the runbook to prefetch KV for top 50 prefixes on deploy.
jasper (sales): Thanks team. I'll update Cedar post-call and attach the trace command + security packet. Call in 10. :thumbsup:
